$comment: Single source of truth for the Google Play release of Singular 80.
Every script in ../scripts reads this file. Change a value here, run
`npm run preflight`, and the same value shows up in the AAB, the store
listing validator and the docs checklist.
Fields marked TODO need input from the developer - see ../docs/PLAN.md.

keystoreEnv.$comment: Passwords never live in this repo. Export them before building.

listing.$comment: Free-form text lives in ../listing/*.md - the validator reads it from there.

owner.$comment: TODO: fill in before the first Play Console submission. Legal texts reference these.
owner.legalName: TODO: legal name (as on your ID)
owner.privateEmail: TODO: address Google uses to reach you (may differ)
owner.organization: TODO: name of the legally responsible entity or 'personal account'

urls.$comment: TODO: must be publicly reachable over HTTPS and must NOT be a localhost/private address.
